items.problem: `efficiency`: profile build runs one `storage.get_user_record` query (`SELECT ... FROM "user" WHERE user_id = $1`, server/core/storage/rows.ts:88) per input user ID, and `get_public_profiles` has no limit on the user ID count. Measured calls of one `get_public_profiles`: 1 ID gives 1, 3 give 3, 6 give 6, 12 give 12. The growing amount is the list that the caller passes, e.g. the channel list at server/core/chat/index.ts:398 and the block list at server/core/block-report/index.ts:428. `storage` has no read of several `user` rows and `## behavior` of the spec sets `get_user_record` as the source, so the fix needs a spec change in `storage` and `public-profile`.
